name: DeSoto State Park

fees.note: $38-80 a night for an RV campsite. The price changes by site and night, higher on weekends and busy dates. No out-of-state rate. Every bookable night on the park's reservation calendar for two weeks from 2026-10-13 and from 2027-06-15, read 2026-10-12.

source: https://reserve.alapark.com/desoto/campsites (Calendar View, every campsite's price for the two weeks from 2026-10-13 and from 2027-06-15 with an Alabama zip, read 2026-10-12; Cheaha re-read with a Pennsylvania zip showed the same prices)
